e.title: MPFA 中介人规管与执法：强积金中介人的规管、执法统计与常见不当行为罚则
e.title_en: MPFA intermediary regulation and enforcement: supervision of MPF intermediaries, enforcement statistics, and penalties for common improper conduct
e.title_hk: MPFA 中介人規管與執法：強積金中介人的規管、執法統計與常見不當行為罰則
e.summary: 香港积金局对强积金中介人的规管与执法栏目：发布执法统计、常见不当行为与罚则、执法提示，并覆盖中介人与受托人两侧；站点提供英文、繁体与简体中文
e.summary_en: The MPFA’s supervision and enforcement sections for MPF intermediaries: it publishes enforcement statistics, common improper conduct and penalties, and enforcement alerts, covering both intermediaries and trustees, with the site available in English, traditional and simplified Chinese
e.summary_hk: 香港積金局對強積金中介人的規管與執法欄目：發布執法統計、常見不當行為與罰則、執法提示，並覆蓋中介人與受託人兩側；站點提供英文、繁體與簡體中文
e.body:
**MPFA（Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority，香港强积金计划管理局／积金局）** 的中介人规管与执法栏目——本条目补的是**「中介人执法与处罚公开」这一形态**：**实测「中介登记/中介监管」形态为 0**，而**本条目给的是该形态中「处罚与不当行为」这一侧**（同轮 [[eiopa-registers]] 给的是**超国家层的登记册与合并处罚数据**）。

⭐ **与池内已有条目的分工（本词条特别写明）**：池内已有 **[[mpfa]]（积金局本身）**、**[[mpf-fund-platform]]（积金局基金平台，属基金与收费数据）**、**[[mpfe]]（强积金考试）** 与 **[[peak-exam-centre]]（IIQE / MPFE 官方考点）**——**即「机构」「基金数据」「考试」三块都已有人覆盖**；**本条目补的是此前完全没有的「对中介人的规管与执法」**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「Regulation（规管）」页 `/en/supervision/mpf-intermediaries` 实测 94.2KB，标题实测「Regulation - MPFA」**；⭐ **「Enforcement Statistics（执法统计）」页 `/en/enforcement/enforcement-statistics` 实测 98.6KB，标题实测「Enforcement Statistics - MPFA」**；⭐ **「Common Improper Conduct and Penalties（常见不当行为与罚则）」页 `/en/enforcement/mpf-intermediary/common-offences-and-penalties` 实测 89.9KB，标题实测「Common Improper Conduct and Penalties - MPFA」**；**导航逐字实测揭示的执法栏目结构**：**Enforcement** 下含 **Overview**、**MPF Intermediaries**、**MPF Trustees**、**ORSO Employers and Administrators**、**Employers**、**Scheme Members**、**Self-employed Persons**、**Plan Members**、**Enforcement Statistics**、**Beware of Scams**、**Enforcement Alerts**；**Regulation** 下含 **MPF Trustees** 与 **MPF Intermediaries**；另有 **Approved Supplier Lists（认可供应商名单）**、**Glossary（词汇表）**、**Useful Tools**、**eMPF Platform** 与 **eMPF Platform Oversight**；⭐ **站点实测提供 EN / 繁 / 简 三种语言**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「强积金中介人」这一香港本地的持牌与执法环节**——**MPF 中介人是强积金销售与顾问环节的持牌主体**，**而池内此前只有考试与基金数据**；**对在香港求职或做合规方向的学生，这是了解「谁可以卖强积金、违规会怎样」的官方入口**（可与 [[insurance-broker]]、[[marsh]]、[[howden]] 等中介条目并读——**那些是保险中介，这一条是退休金中介**，**两个牌照体系不同**）。**② ⭐ 「常见不当行为与罚则」是本轮少见的「官方列明的违规清单」**——**监管者把「哪些行为算不当、对应什么罚则」直接写成一页**，**这与 [[eiopa-registers]] 的「撤销注册占 51%」形成两种公开口径**：**一个是汇总统计、一个是行为清单**；**对做合规与消费者保护的学生，两者互补**（可与 [[hk-icb]] 的投诉个案、[[fos-uk]] 的争议裁决并读——**投诉、裁决、处罚是消费者保护链条上的三个不同环节**）。**③ 「执法提示（Enforcement Alerts）」与「提防骗案（Beware of Scams）」是两个少见的栏目**——**监管者主动发布风险提示**，**对做投资者/保单持有人教育的学生是现成素材**。**④ 执法对象覆盖中介人、受托人、ORSO 雇主与计划成员多侧**——**这一点值得注意：同一执法栏目按「被规管主体类型」组织**，**而不只是按「违规类型」组织**，**是一种以主体为中心的信息架构**。**⑤ 站点为 EN / 繁 / 简 三语**——**对本站三语读者是直接的可用性优势**（**但本次仅核实语言切换存在，未核实简繁版本的内容完整度是否与英文一致**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**三个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、以及导航逐字实测的执法与规管栏目结构、语言切换**，**但未打开执法统计的具体数字、未打开常见不当行为与罚则的具体条目、未打开任何执法提示或骗案警示内容**，因此**不能转述任何执法案件数量、罚款金额、被处罚机构名称或具体罚则条文**；**② 我猜测的两条路径 `/en/enforcement/statistics` 与 `/en/supervision/mpf-intermediaries/statistics` 均实测 404**（**真实路径为 `/en/enforcement/enforcement-statistics`**）——**又一次「不要猜路径、从导航反查」**；**③ 「执法统计」页的具体统计维度、覆盖年份与更新频率本次未核实**；**④ 中介人登记册本身（可供公众查询持牌中介的检索入口）本次未定位到并核实**——**故本词条不主张提供一个可检索的中介人登记册**（**这一点与同轮 [[eiopa-registers]] 形成对照：那边的登记册我因 403 未访问，这边我未定位到**）；**⑤ 简繁中文版本与英文版本的内容是否一致本次未核实**；**⑥** 本词条**不主张** MPFA 提供精算工具或基金层面的投资数据（**后者见 [[mpf-fund-platform]]**）。**核实说明**：`/en/supervision/mpf-intermediaries`（94.2KB）、`/en/enforcement/enforcement-statistics`（98.6KB）、`/en/enforcement/mpf-intermediary/common-offences-and-penalties`（89.9KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取导航与标题；两条猜测路径实测 404；**未打开统计数字、罚则条目、执法提示或骗案警示的内容**。
e.body_en:
The intermediary regulation and enforcement sections of the **MPFA (Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority, Hong Kong)** — this entry adds the **"public enforcement and penalties against intermediaries"** form: the **"intermediary register / intermediary regulation" form measured zero**, and **this entry supplies its "penalties and improper conduct" side** (while [[eiopa-registers]] in the same round supplies the **supranational registers and consolidated sanction data**).

⭐ **Division of labour with existing entries (stated explicitly here)**: the corpus already holds **[[mpfa]] (the authority itself)**, **[[mpf-fund-platform]] (its fund platform, covering funds and fees)**, **[[mpfe]] (the MPF examination)** and **[[peak-exam-centre]] (the official IIQE / MPFE test centre)** — **i.e. "the institution", "fund data" and "examinations" are all covered**; **this entry adds the previously absent "regulation of and enforcement against intermediaries"**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"Regulation" page `/en/supervision/mpf-intermediaries` measures 94.2KB with the measured title "Regulation - MPFA"**; ⭐ the **"Enforcement Statistics" page `/en/enforcement/enforcement-statistics` measures 98.6KB with the measured title "Enforcement Statistics - MPFA"**; ⭐ the **"Common Improper Conduct and Penalties" page measures 89.9KB with the measured title "Common Improper Conduct and Penalties - MPFA"**; **navigation read verbatim reveals the enforcement structure**: under **Enforcement** — **Overview**, **MPF Intermediaries**, **MPF Trustees**, **ORSO Employers and Administrators**, **Employers**, **Scheme Members**, **Self-employed Persons**, **Plan Members**, **Enforcement Statistics**, **Beware of Scams** and **Enforcement Alerts**; under **Regulation** — **MPF Trustees** and **MPF Intermediaries**; there are also **Approved Supplier Lists**, a **Glossary**, **Useful Tools**, the **eMPF Platform** and **eMPF Platform Oversight**; ⭐ **the site measurably offers EN / traditional Chinese / simplified Chinese**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the Hong Kong local licensing and enforcement link for MPF intermediaries** — **MPF intermediaries are the licensed parties in MPF sales and advice**, **and the corpus previously had only examinations and fund data**; **for students seeking work in Hong Kong or moving into compliance, this is the official entry point for understanding who may sell MPF and what happens on breach** (readable with intermediary entries such as [[insurance-broker]], [[marsh]] and [[howden]] — **those are insurance intermediaries, this is retirement-scheme intermediaries, and the two licensing regimes differ**). **② ⭐ "Common Improper Conduct and Penalties" is the rare "officially enumerated misconduct list"** — **the regulator sets out on one page which conduct counts as improper and what penalties attach**, **giving a second disclosure style alongside [[eiopa-registers]]’ "51% of sanctions were registration withdrawals"**: **one is aggregate statistics, the other a conduct list**, **and for compliance and consumer-protection work the two complement each other** (readable with [[hk-icb]]’s complaint cases and [[fos-uk]]’s dispute decisions — **complaints, decisions and penalties are three different links in the consumer-protection chain**). **③ "Enforcement Alerts" and "Beware of Scams" are two uncommon sections** — **a regulator proactively issuing risk warnings**, **ready material for work on investor and policyholder education**. **④ Enforcement covers intermediaries, trustees, ORSO employers and scheme members** — **notably, the enforcement section is organised by the type of regulated party as well as by type of breach**, **a subject-centred information architecture**. **⑤ The site is trilingual EN / traditional / simplified Chinese** — **a direct usability advantage for this wiki’s readers** (**though this check verified only that the language switch exists, not whether the Chinese content matches the English in completeness**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **three pages’ existence, titles and sizes, plus the enforcement and regulation structure and language switch read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no enforcement statistics figures, no individual misconduct or penalty item, and no enforcement alert or scam warning content**, so **no enforcement case count, fine amount, sanctioned firm name or specific penalty provision can be restated**; **② both paths I guessed — `/en/enforcement/statistics` and `/en/supervision/mpf-intermediaries/statistics` — measured 404** (**the real path is `/en/enforcement/enforcement-statistics`**) — **another "do not guess paths; read the navigation"**; **③ the enforcement statistics page’s dimensions, year coverage and update frequency were not verified**; **④ a searchable public register of licensed intermediaries was not located or verified in this check** — **so this entry does not claim to provide a searchable intermediary register** (**note the contrast with [[eiopa-registers]] in the same round: there the register app was unreachable due to 403; here none was located**); **⑤ whether the Chinese versions match the English in content was not verified**; **⑥** this entry **does not claim MPFA provides actuarial tools or fund-level investment data** (**the latter is covered by [[mpf-fund-platform]]**). **Verification note**: `/en/supervision/mpf-intermediaries` (94.2KB), `/en/enforcement/enforcement-statistics` (98.6KB) and `/en/enforcement/mpf-intermediary/common-offences-and-penalties` (89.9KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with navigation and titles read verbatim; two guessed paths measured 404; **no statistics figures, penalty items, enforcement alerts or scam warnings were opened**.
e.body_hk:
**MPFA（Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority，香港強積金計劃管理局／積金局）** 的中介人規管與執法欄目——本條目補的是**「中介人執法與處罰公開」這一形態**：**實測「中介登記／中介監管」形態為 0**，而**本條目給的是該形態中「處罰與不當行為」這一側**（同輪 [[eiopa-registers]] 給的是**超國家層的登記冊與合併處罰數據**）。

⭐ **與池內已有條目的分工（本詞條特別寫明）**：池內已有 **[[mpfa]]（積金局本身）**、**[[mpf-fund-platform]]（基金平台）**、**[[mpfe]]（強積金考試）** 與 **[[peak-exam-centre]]（官方考點）**——**即「機構」「基金數據」「考試」三塊都已覆蓋**；**本條目補的是此前完全沒有的「對中介人的規管與執法」**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **「Regulation」頁 94.2KB，標題實測「Regulation - MPFA」**；⭐ **「Enforcement Statistics」頁 98.6KB，標題實測「Enforcement Statistics - MPFA」**；⭐ **「Common Improper Conduct and Penalties」頁 89.9KB，標題實測「Common Improper Conduct and Penalties - MPFA」**；**導航逐字實測**：**Enforcement** 下含 **Overview／MPF Intermediaries／MPF Trustees／ORSO Employers and Administrators／Employers／Scheme Members／Self-employed Persons／Plan Members／Enforcement Statistics／Beware of Scams／Enforcement Alerts**；**Regulation** 下含 **MPF Trustees／MPF Intermediaries**；另有 **Approved Supplier Lists／Glossary／Useful Tools／eMPF Platform**；⭐ **站點實測提供 EN／繁／簡 三語**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「強積金中介人」這一香港本地的持牌與執法環節**——**對在香港求職或做合規方向的學生，這是了解「誰可以賣強積金、違規會怎樣」的官方入口**（可與 [[insurance-broker]]、[[marsh]]、[[howden]] 並讀——**兩個牌照體系不同**）。**② ⭐ 「常見不當行為與罰則」是罕見的「官方列明的違規清單」**——**與 [[eiopa-registers]] 的「撤銷註冊佔 51%」形成兩種公開口徑**：**一個是匯總統計、一個是行為清單**；可與 [[hk-icb]] 的投訴個案、[[fos-uk]] 的爭議裁決並讀——**投訴、裁決、處罰是消費者保護鏈條上的三個不同環節**。**③ 「執法提示」與「提防騙案」是兩個少見的欄目**——**監管者主動發布風險提示**。**④ 執法對象覆蓋中介人、受託人、ORSO 僱主與計劃成員多側**——**是按「被規管主體類型」組織資訊架構**。**⑤ 站點為 EN／繁／簡 三語**（**但未核實簡繁版本與英文內容是否一致**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**三個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航逐字實測的欄目結構與語言切換**，**但未打開執法統計的具體數字、未打開常見不當行為與罰則的具體條目、未打開任何執法提示或騙案警示內容**，故**不能轉述任何執法案件數量、罰款金額、被處罰機構名稱或具體罰則條文**；**② 我猜測的兩條路徑 `/en/enforcement/statistics` 與 `/en/supervision/mpf-intermediaries/statistics` 均實測 404**（**真實路徑為 `/en/enforcement/enforcement-statistics`**）；**③ 「執法統計」頁的統計維度、覆蓋年份與更新頻率未核實**；**④ 可供公眾查詢持牌中介的登記冊檢索入口本次未定位到並核實**——**故不主張提供可檢索的中介人登記冊**（**與同輪 [[eiopa-registers]] 形成對照：那邊因 403 未訪問，這邊未定位到**）；**⑤ 簡繁版本與英文內容是否一致未核實**；**⑥** 本詞條**不主張** MPFA 提供精算工具或基金層面投資數據（**後者見 [[mpf-fund-platform]]**）**。**核實說明**：三個 URL 均 HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取導航與標題；兩條猜測路徑實測 404；**未打開統計數字、罰則條目、執法提示或騙案警示內容**。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（⭐/en/supervision/mpf-intermediaries 94.2KB 标题「Regulation - MPFA」；⭐/en/enforcement/enforcement-statistics 98.6KB 标题「Enforcement Statistics - MPFA」；⭐/en/enforcement/mpf-intermediary/common-offences-and-penalties 89.9KB 标题「Common Improper Conduct and Penalties - MPFA」；导航逐字实测 Enforcement 下设 Overview / MPF Intermediaries / MPF Trustees / ORSO Employers and Administrators / Employers / Scheme Members / Self-employed Persons / Plan Members / Enforcement Statistics / Beware of Scams / Enforcement Alerts；Regulation 下设 MPF Trustees 与 MPF Intermediaries；另有 Approved Supplier Lists / Glossary / Useful Tools / eMPF Platform；站点提供 EN/繁/简 三语）+ 两条猜测路径 /en/enforcement/statistics 与 /en/supervision/mpf-intermediaries/statistics 均实测 404（真实为 /en/enforcement/enforcement-statistics）+ ★池内「中介登记/中介监管」形态 0，且已有 mpfa / mpf-fund-platform / mpfe / peak-exam-centre 三块，本条目补「中介人规管与执法」；未打开执法统计数字、罚则条目、执法提示或骗案警示；未定位到可检索的中介人登记册；未核实三语版本内容一致性
